title: Claudia Jordan Throws Shade At Kid Rock After He Disses Oprah Winfrey, "He's Still Alive?"
htmlContent:
Multiplatinum artist Kid Rock smashed TV icon Oprah Winfrey on Saturday and called her a "fraud" Winfrey supported the Pennsylvania Senate campaign of Democrat John Fetterman on his Republican adversary, Dr. Mehmet Oz, whom Winfrey knew and worked with for decades.

“Oprah helped Dr. Oz with his career,” Kid Rock tweeted. “I assume because she vetted him and found him to be a wonderful person. Now she is against him. Oprah is a fraud. -Kid Rock.”

Winfrey, a Democrat, announced last week that she supported Fetterman's senatorial campaign despite his long relationship with Oz.

Oz has become an important health specialist. The Oprah Winfrey Show” before he got his own talk show in 2009, which was produced by Winfrey’s company Harpo. His show ended in January. 

“I’ll tell you all this, if I lived in Pennsylvania, I would have already cast my vote for John Fetterman for many reasons,” Winfrey said.

“Oprah is widely regarded as the person who helped launch Dr. Oz’s career, and knows him well,” the campaign said.

After seeing Kid Rock's comments on The Neighborhood Talk Actress and radio host Claudia Jordan responded to Rock.

Jordan commented, "He's still alive."

Speaking of Jordan, she recently opened up about her time on on the Deal or No Deal with Meghan Markle testified that they treated her like a bimbo.

Meghan Markle’s ‘Archetypes’ Podcast: Biggest Revelations About Royal Life.

“For clarity — yes getting a modeling gig on a game show isn’t necessarily about your intellect but every show the executive producers picked five models with the most outgoing and fun personalities to place mics on who they knew would engage with the contestants,” the Couple’s Retreat star, 49, wrote via her Instagram Stories on Tuesday, October 18, about her own experience working on the game show. “And Deal or No Deal never treated us like bimbos. We got so many opportunities because of that show.”
